summary.headline: Ptolemy and Porphyry in Codex
summary.text: Catalog entry for folios 1 and 139 of a Modena codex: an anonymous commentary on Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos, ending with a note also found in Codex 9, followed by Porphyry’s introduction to the apotelesmatic art with scholia attributed to Demophilus.
